title: NEMAR live progress, nemar.progress.v1
description: The closed object a NEMAR pipeline job reports while it runs (ADR 0134 decision 3): in the runner heartbeat's progress field, or as the body of POST /compute/jobs/:id/progress under the job token. Copied byte for byte from nemarOrg/nemar-cli (shared/contract/compute-progress.schema.json) by nemarOrg/nemar-process. The root has no constraint; each shape is a member of $defs. Each checkpoint's counts have the shape of neuroschema definitions/checkpointCounts.schema.json. Rules a schema cannot state are the reader's: counts names exactly the recipe version's declared checkpoints except stored; passed + failed + skipped <= total in every column; every column has the same total; checkpoint is a key of counts; each failure names a key of counts, and no checkpoint lists more failures than it counts as failed or skipped. The serialized object is at most 8192 bytes. Reports come at most once a minute; the Worker refuses a second report within 50 seconds.

CheckpointName.description: A checkpoint a recipe declares (neuroschema processingTypes checkpointName).

FailureCode.description: A failure or skip word (neuroschema processingTypes failureCode).

ProgressPath.description: A recording's relative path: printable ASCII without a backslash, no leading slash, no URI scheme, no .. segment.

CheckpointCounts.description: One checkpoint's counts of recordings: the shape of neuroschema checkpointCounts.

ProgressFailure.description: One failed or skipped recording: its path, the failure word, the step (null when unknown) and the checkpoint it counts against.

ProgressReportResponse.description: The answer to an accepted report. Open.
